mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4, significantly reducing atovaquone plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy, particularly important for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PCP) prophylaxis or treatment.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination is necessary, monitor clinical response closely and consider alternative anticonvulsant (e.g., valproic acid) or alternative anti-Pneumocystis agent.
